faq.q: What can I expect during these diagnostic tests?
faq.a: Each test includes a comprehensive consultation, a simple collection process, and a detailed explanation of results. Our specialists ensure you feel informed and supported throughout.

faq.q: How soon will I get my results?
faq.a: Results are typically available within 7-10 days, depending on the complexity of the test. We prioritize accuracy and timely reporting to help you move forward confidently.

faq.q: Will these tests help if I’ve already had IVF treatments?
faq.a: Absolutely. Our diagnostic tests are particularly beneficial for those who have faced IVF failures or unexplained fertility issues. They provide deeper insights that standard tests may miss.

about.name: Endometrial Receptivity & Function Assay (ERFA – The Soil Test)
about.description: The ERFA, or Endometrial Soil Test, is a diagnostic tool that assesses the readiness of the uterine lining (endometrium) for successful embryo implantation. This comprehensive test analyzes multiple biomarkers to pinpoint factors affecting fertility and implantation success.

about.name: Endo-Immune Test
about.description: This test delves into the immune landscape of the endometrium, essential for maintaining a balance between pro-inflammatory and anti-inflammatory responses. By evaluating cytokines and immune cells, it helps identify potential immune-related issues causing recurrent miscarriages or failed implantation.

about.name: Endometrial Infection Test (EIT)
about.description: The Endometrial Infection Test detects hidden bacterial or viral infections and chronic endometritis.
